pages.title: Calendar · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: Bhajans, study circles and seva (service) across Delhi NCR. All free, all welcome.

pages.title: Get involved · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: These sevas (service) still need Sevadal members. Pick one, tell us you’re coming, and turn up. That’s all.

pages.title: Study circle · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: A small group reads one teaching aloud, asks what it means for this week and sits with it until it is plain.

pages.title: Eye camp · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: A free morning of eye check-ups, run with a partner hospital. Most people leave with reading glasses; some leave with a date for cataract surgery, also free.

pages.title: Blood donation · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: Blood donation camps run with district hospitals and licensed blood banks, so every unit goes where it is needed.

pages.title: Medical camp · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: A free general check-up with doctors from a partner hospital, with medicines handed out at the camp.

pages.title: Narayan Seva (food) · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: Cooked meals prepared at the centre and served by hand, every week of the year. Nothing is collected from the people we serve.

pages.title: Bal Vikas class · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: Bal Vikas (blossoming of the child) gives children an hour a week with the five human values, through stories, songs and silent sitting.

pages.title: Disaster relief · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: When floods or other disasters strike, centres gather supplies and Sevadal and deliver them with local authorities.

pages.title: Cleanliness drive · SSSSO Delhi NCR
pages.description: Weekend mornings of planting, clean-ups and water-saving drives, coordinated with local resident associations.
